gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya has a lowercase that towers over its own capitals, with s curves that turn easily. And Autour One looks traced with a marker above it, bold and expressive, so a plain sans body feels quietly grounded.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hm: Round, marker-bold headlines with attitude. Autour One has no calligraphic swell on its downstrokes, so if it shrinks, its weight starts to crowd Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, whose high x-height and gapped rounds need space.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Expressive neon-tube lettering leads here, Autour One bending its constant-thickness strokes into bold shapes. Noto Sans Palmyrene follows in a modern sans with curves that stop short of closing, giving the loud heading something quieter beneath it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-h: Autour One draws every letter as a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, bold and a little showy. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau lets it speak, its open curves staying quiet.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Zero stroke contrast runs through every Autour One letter, giving the heading a bold, expressive hum. And Noto Sans PhagsPa, a sans-serif with see-through c openings, brings an approachable, contemporary ease underneath.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-phoenicia: Autour One has no sparkle at all, just a constant stroke weight carrying its bold, expressive look. Noto Sans Phoenician is where this pair shines brightest in its generous lowercase height and s curves open at both ends.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Autour One handles the shouting, its rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord and capitals that hardly rise above the lowercase. But Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi does the talking, with gaping e mouths and an approachable, professional manner.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Autour One keeps a monoline skeleton under its bold, expressive display look. Noto Sans Rejang then supplies lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, so the sans text stays clear and open beside it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-runic: Letters that look bent from a single wire give Autour One its bold, expressive signature, a sharp contrast to what follows. Noto Sans Runic reads with a big x-height and open curves.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan reads as an approachable, professional plain sans, its hefty lowercase full of daylight inside the curves. Autour One's cord-like rounded strokes sit above it, bold.
